exam: 112年公務人員特種考試外交領事人員及外交行政人員考試、112年公務人員特種考試國際經濟商務人員考試、112年公務人員特種考試民航人員考試、112年公務人員特種考試原住民族考試
subject: 國際傳播(以英文命題及作答)
classes: 外交領事人員英文組二

essays.text: In accounting for the dynamics of current international communication, whatare the explanatory frameworks provided by the World System Theory andCultural Globalization Theories? What are their limitations?(25%)

In the recent rise of streaming services, the traditional film industry has beenseriously impacted. How has the popularity of Netflix challenged theHollywood’s global dominance in the ⑴production and ⑵distribution of theaudio-visual products?(25%)

Based on the source and nature of information, international politicalpropaganda can be divided into three types: white, grey and black propaganda.Please explain their differences and illustrate with examples.(25%)

mcq.q: Which of the following is among the five countries that coordinated the evacuation operation of the JewishUkrainians?

Which of the following countries led the way of proposing the principle of“cultural exception,”assertingthat culture is not a commodity and, therefore, should not be included as a category of free trade in theGATT Uruguay Round of trade negotiation before WTO was formed?

The world renowned communication scholar Harold Lasswell argued that there are three key factors towinning a modern war. In addition to staging a war and blocking the economy, which of the followingis the other one?

News about Taiwan seldom made international headlines, yet Taiwan’s“salmon chaos”and“Taroko trainderailment” in 2021 have received intensive coverage by the foreign press. Which of the followingterminologies of international communication best captures the circumstance?
Which of the following concepts was proposed by Japanese scholar Koichi Iwabuchi to modify thetheoretical perspectives of cultural proximity?

British sociologist Anthony Giddens argued that globalization is one of the outcomes of modernity, and heproposed four highly interrelated dimensions of globalization. Which of the following is NOT included?
Which of the following statements about public diplomacy is NOT correct?
opts: The goal of long-term public diplomacy is to increase support in the international community to achievethe success of singular political advocacy.
For the government, one of the goals of public diplomacy is that its foreign policy wins support fromits people.
When public diplomacy is promoted, being labeled as propaganda should be avoided at all costs sothat negative impressions would not happen.
The main argument of American public diplomacy during the Cold War was to convince the Europeanpeople that the American system of democracy and capitalism is superior to the Soviet political system.

mcq.q: In the era of digital convergence, social media platforms contribute to effective internationalcommunication. Which of the following statements is NOT correct regarding Australian government’srequest for platform operators to pay for journalism?
opts: Australia has passed “Platform Fairness Payment Bill.”The bill mandates that digital platform operatorssuch as Facebook and Google should remunerate journalism for the contents they produced.
Google and major Australian media companies have reached a cooperation agreement on payment.
Facebook once blocked Australian users from viewing or sharing Australian news contents on theplatform, including those from outside the country.
During the time when Facebook blocked Australian news, non-news pages run by government agenciesand charity organizations were also blocked by mistake.

mcq.q: How did Al Jazeera enter the US TV market when it was officially launched in 2013?
opts: By becoming a cable system operator.
By acquiring an existing US cable channel.
By setting up a satellite channel.
By providing live streaming over the Internet.

mcq.q: Which of the following incidents led to the establishment of the Independent Media Center (IMC) aimingto facilitate an international digital platform for citizen journalism?
opts: The protests against the IMF in Washington DC in 2005.
The Yellow Vests Movement in France in 2018.

mcq.q: Which of the following international organizations proposed“Universal Declaration on Cultural Diversity”?
opts: United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO).

mcq.q: Which of the following statements about the prevalence of SVOD (subscription video on demand) andOTT (over-the-top services) is NOT correct?
opts: SVOD and OTT provide accurate recommendation mechanisms, enabling viewers to access their favoredcontent.
According to the theory of audience commodity, SVOD and OTT are free of advertising. Therefore,the audience can refrain from labor exploitation.
The accuracy of the recommendation mechanisms provided by SVOD and OTT relies on the collectionof a huge data produced by the users’digital footprint.
SVOD and OTT service providers entrust data analytics companies to collect the data of social mediadiscussion as the basis for production and programming.

mcq.q: Which of the following terms is used by British sociologist Alan Bryman (2004) for criticizing the globalcommercial transformation of commodities or environments into something excessively simplified,tightly controlled, and heavily reliant on emotional labor?
Governments are frequently expected to legislate laws to address the social issues of the Internet. Whichof the following social issues was addressed by the U.S. Communications Decency Act of 1996?
Which of the following countries held a referendum in March 2018 to decide whether or not the mandatorylicense fee for public broadcasters should be abolished?
Agence Havas, formally founded in 1835, is the predecessor of which of the following news agencies?
What does the term“issue monitoring”in public diplomacy refer to?
opts: Specific issues are aimed at and their development is tracked.
The breakout time of an issue is confirmed.
Various international news databases are subscribed to.
Protests are issued officially against unfair media.

mcq.q: Which of the following roles that global media play in determining the diplomatic strategies can beidentified as the“CNN effect”?
James Grunig and Todd Hunt have developed a theory of four models of public relations. Which of thefollowing statements is correct when we apply these four models to public diplomacy?
opts: The press agent/publicity model promises to disseminate the most accurate content.
The public information model is aimed at conveying information, rather than attempting to persuade.
The two-wayasymmetric model is targeted at increasing mutual recognition and understanding, with reciprocitybenefiting both parties.
The two-way symmetric model resorts to means or strategies undisclosed to the public in order to bepersuasive.

mcq.q: Which of the following is the major impact brought by the advancement of Internet technologies on theprocess and the condition of foreign policy?
opts: Internet technologies have created echo chambers where diplomats can monopolize or control diplomaticagendas.
Internet technologies have contributed to faster information in lesser time; accordingly, diplomats needto filter, analyze, and respond to information within the shortest period of time.
The advance of Internet technologies has reduced both the amount and the source of information.
Internet technologies have reduced the target subjects of diplomatic work.
